name: vn.fpt.campusstay.AdminConfigIT
comment: Admin configuration screens of Settings (TC-CFG-NNN). Changes shared reference data, so it gets its own database.

methods.name: listsTerms
methods.comment: TC-CFG-002: Terms list with string ids, windows and status labels.

methods.name: termValidationNamesFields
methods.comment: TC-CFG-003 (negative): missing and inconsistent windows are named per field.

methods.name: publishTermLifecycle
methods.comment: TC-CFG-004: a Draft is invisible to students and takes the default Deposit window; publishing shows it; a second publish and an overlapping Term are refused.

methods.name: roomTypes
methods.comment: TC-CFG-005: Room Types with inventory counts; mutual invite only for 2 Beds; names are unique.

methods.name: roomTypeBedsChangeTheInventory
methods.comment: TC-CFG-006: changing the Beds of a Room Type adds or retires Beds in its Rooms.

methods.name: roomClasses
methods.comment: TC-CFG-007: Room Classes show where they are used and the deposit rate; the surcharge is bounded.

methods.name: feesAndRefundRules
methods.comment: TC-CFG-008: fees and refund rules save as one document; a new rule gets an id; bad rates are refused. The seven refund triggers of spec §9 are there (V10, V42).

methods.name: eligibilityRules
methods.comment: TC-CFG-009: criteria switches and priority groups (order, new group, member counts).

methods.name: matchingSnapshots
methods.comment: TC-CFG-010: weights must total 100%; saving creates the next snapshot; a dry run allocates nothing.

methods.name: systemParameters
methods.comment: TC-CFG-011: system parameters are typed; an invalid value is named by its key.

methods.name: utilityPolicy
methods.comment: TC-CFG-013: Admin › Utility loads with its option lists, rejects values outside them and audits a change.

methods.name: managerCannotConfigure
methods.comment: TC-CFG-012 (permission): a Manager cannot open Admin configuration.

methods.name: demoToolsOffByDefault
methods.comment: TC-CFG-029: the demo tools are off unless the server turns them on (DEMO_TOOLS); a reset is refused.

methods.name: term
methods.signature: term(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.Integer)
methods.comment: A complete Term; registration closes before the stay, results a week later, Balance due before Check-in.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.AdminFurnitureIT
comment: Admin › Furniture: furniture types, their value and Room Class requirements (spec §6.19; TC-INV-013, 014, 026).

methods.name: managesFurnitureTypes
methods.comment: TC-INV-013: the Admin lists the furniture types with their items, adds one (code and names checked, the code fixed afterwards) and cannot make a type a Room Class requires standard; other roles are refused.

methods.name: setsRoomClassRequirements
methods.comment: TC-INV-014: each Room Class lists the furniture it requires; the Admin replaces a class's requirements, only with active class-defining types and sensible quantities, and conformance follows at once.

methods.name: setsFurnitureValue
methods.comment: TC-INV-026: each furniture type is personal (furniture, one per Bed) or shared by the Room (appliances and fixtures) and has a real price (0–1,000,000,000 VND, empty while not set); four condition levels give the share of that price an item is still worth (100, 75, 50, 0 %). The Admin sets the price and adds, renames, revalues or removes levels (a Vietnamese name, the English one optional, 0–100 %, listed best first); Managers may not.

methods.name: handoverLevelsStay
methods.comment: TC-INV-027: the four condition levels the room handover records its conditions on (Intact, Partly damaged, More than half damaged, Completely damaged) cannot be removed; renaming them or changing their value is allowed.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.AdminSettingsIT
comment: Admin configuration grouped by subject and the rules screens (spec §6.17, §9; TC-CFG-024, 025): settings say where they act and are announced when they change; Who may apply counts the students failing each check; matching weights are levels; the dry run compares the draft with the rules in use.

methods.name: groupedSettings
methods.comment: TC-CFG-024: each group lists its settings with where they act; an out-of-range value is refused; a saved change is audited and announced to students; grouped settings left System parameters; only the Admin edits.

methods.name: rulesScreens
methods.comment: TC-CFG-025: Who may apply gives the students failing each check now and the checks without a switch; weights read as levels and save from levels (Very important counts twice); the dry run of four approved Applications shows the draft next to the rules in use, with an example Room.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.AdminUsersIT
comment: Admin › Users and Roles, permission matrix, Audit Log, and the invite → set password → change password flow.

methods.name: listsBackOfficeUsersWithFilters
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-011: the list holds back-office accounts only, with labels and string ids; filters by role and Block.

methods.name: invitedUserSetsAndChangesPassword
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-012: an invited Staff sets the password from the emailed link (one use only), signs in with the Block scope, and a password change keeps the current session but signs out the others.

methods.name: inviteIsValidated
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-013 (negative): invite validation names each field.

methods.name: disablingRevokesSessions
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-014: disabling a user signs them out at once and is written to the Audit Log.

methods.name: adminCannotDisableThemselves
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-015 (negative): the Admin cannot lock themselves out.

methods.name: staffCannotManageUsers
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-016 (permission): Staff cannot open Admin screens.

methods.name: permissionMatrixComesFromTheRuleTable
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-017: the permission matrix is the enforced rule table.

methods.name: auditLogListsSignIns
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-018: Audit Log filters, labels and retention; a bad range is refused.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.AnnouncementIT
comment: Announcements and the students' board (spec §6.5, §10, D-08; TC-NTF-041…043): written by hand for an audience, shown on the board and in the bell with a read state per student, and written by the system for every money or policy change.

methods.name: livesIn
methods.comment: The test seed's Fall 2026 is in stay: the student holds a Bed in it.

methods.name: adminAnnouncesToEveryStudent
methods.comment: TC-NTF-041: the Admin writes a pinned announcement for all students; a student reads it at the top of the board and in the bell, unread; marking it read in the bell (id {@code ann-…}) updates both; the Admin sees one read.

methods.name: staffAnnounceToTheirBlocks
methods.comment: TC-NTF-042: Staff write only to the residents of their Blocks: everybody or another Block is refused; the residents of the Block read it and other students do not; Staff end their own announcement; students cannot write one.

methods.name: policyChangesAreAnnounced
methods.comment: TC-NTF-043: a change of the Deposit (Admin) and of a Block's settings (Manager) become change announcements with the old and new values, in both languages; a Block's change reaches only its residents.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.ApplicationsIT
comment: Application wizard, stay length, roommate pairs, cancellation and expiry (TC-APP-NNN). Each test uses its own students.

methods.name: catalogAndEligibility
methods.comment: TC-APP-001: the student's Term is the open one; catalog prices and eligibility for it.

methods.name: submitsApplicationWithDeposit
methods.comment: TC-APP-002: submit with a Deposit Invoice, then the list, detail, Home and notification; a second one is refused.

methods.name: applicationIsValidated
methods.comment: TC-APP-003 (negative): a contact field given must be valid; consent and roommate rules are named per field.

methods.name: contactComesFromTheProfile
methods.comment: TC-APP-027: the wizard no longer asks for a contact (R-16): an Application without one is accepted and its snapshot is the contact on the student's profile, which stays as it was.

methods.name: roommateCheckIsPrivacySafeAndLimited
methods.comment: TC-APP-004 (privacy): the same answer for every unusable code, and a limited number of checks.

methods.name: invitedPairIsSubmittedTogether
methods.comment: TC-APP-005 (business rule): an invited pair reaches the office together: the first to pay waits as Awaiting Roommate; both are Submitted when the second Deposit is paid.

methods.name: declinedInvitationFallsBackToAutomaticMatching
methods.comment: TC-APP-006: a declined invitation leaves the inviter matched automatically.

methods.name: cancellationVoidsOrRefunds
methods.comment: TC-APP-007: cancelling voids an unpaid Deposit; a paid one is refunded by the rule; the student may apply again.

methods.name: unpaidApplicationExpires
methods.comment: TC-APP-008 (job): an unpaid Application expires when its Deposit window passes; its Invoice is voided.

methods.name: applicationsArePrivate
methods.comment: TC-APP-009 (permission): Staff cannot use student screens; another student's Application is 404.

methods.name: stayTermsOnTheApplication
methods.comment: TC-APP-023: The stay length (spec §6.6, D-13) is 1 to stay.max_terms, capped by the semesters the student has left (stay.program_semesters); it is kept on the Application and shown to the student and the back office; a student who already holds a Bed for the Term cannot apply (not a continuing resident).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.ApplyFlow
comment: Helpers for the Application and payment integration tests: a published Term whose registration is open now (so tests do not depend on the seed's dates), submitting an Application and paying it: the student's "I have transferred" confirmed by a Manager (ADR-22).

methods.name: openTerm
methods.comment: Publishes the test Term once; registration opened yesterday and closes in 30 days.

methods.name: body
methods.comment: Body of {@code POST /applications}; {@code roommate} is raw JSON or null.

methods.name: claim
methods.comment: The student's "I have transferred".

methods.name: attachReceipt
methods.comment: A Manager attaches the transfer receipt to the Invoice's open claim (R-23).

methods.name: confirm
methods.comment: A Manager attaches each claim's receipt, then confirms the claims of the Invoices.

methods.name: pay
methods.comment: Pays the Invoice: the student claims the transfer and a Manager confirms it.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.AssignmentIT
comment: Staff review, the assignment run, conflicts, the Manager's approval and the student's Room (TC-APP-010…011, TC-ASG-010…012). Each test uses its own students.

methods.name: submitted
methods.comment: Applies for a 2-bed Standard Room and pays the Deposit: the Application is Submitted.

methods.name: reviewQueueAndRejection
methods.comment: TC-APP-010: the queue, the review view (opening it starts the review), rejection needs a note, once only.

methods.name: reviewIsScopedByBlock
methods.comment: TC-APP-011 (scope): every Manager sees every Block's Applications (ADR-19); Staff and students cannot review.

methods.name: assignmentRunToAllocation
methods.comment: TC-ASG-010: the Manager approves in bulk, runs, resolves the conflict to the waitlist and commits the Block, which approves it at once (ADR-19): Allocations, Balance Invoices, notifications and My Room. Staff cannot commit.

methods.name: dryRunAndPermissions
methods.comment: TC-ASG-011: a dry run is a preview; students and Staff cannot use runs (ADR-19).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.AssistantIT
comment: The students' AI assistant (ADR-28, A-68) with the model replaced; its Ollama adapter has its own test.

methods.name: answers
methods.comment: The model answers with these replies in turn, the last one again for any further call.

methods.name: answersFromTheStudentsOwnData
methods.comment: TC-AST-001: a student's question reaches the model with the guide in the student's language and the student's own data (their Room, without the check-in pass); the model's answer is returned; the question, a follow-up too, is preceded by a reminder of the language and to answer from the data.

methods.name: checksTheConversationAndTheRole
methods.comment: TC-AST-002: the conversation is checked (not empty, roles user or assistant, ending with a question, at most 2000 characters a message) and only students may use the assistant.

methods.name: neverAsksTheModelForTheDoorCode
methods.comment: TC-AST-003: a question about the door code, in Vietnamese with or without accents or in English, gets the fixed answer pointing to My Room without asking the model, which could make a code up.

methods.name: answersInTheLanguageTheStudentWrites
methods.comment: TC-AST-009: the assistant answers in the language the student writes in: a question with Vietnamese letters gets the Vietnamese guide and reminder even on an English screen; a question without them follows the screen's language.

methods.name: neverShowsAnAnswerInChinese
methods.comment: TC-AST-008: an answer with Chinese characters is never shown: the model is asked once more with its answer and a request to write it in the student's language; if it still has them, the student gets 503 ASSISTANT_NO_ANSWER.

methods.name: limitsQuestionsPerHour
methods.comment: TC-AST-004: a student may ask the configured number of questions per hour, then gets 429.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.AssistantOfflineIT
comment: Without a model server ({@code ASSISTANT_BASE_URL} blank) the assistant says it is off (ADR-28, A-68).

methods.name: offlineWithoutModelServer
methods.comment: TC-AST-005: without a model server the status says off and a question answers 503 ASSISTANT_OFFLINE.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.AuthFlowIT
comment: End-to-end Auth flow against a real PostgreSQL with the Flyway schema and dev seed. Test case IDs follow TC-AUTH-NNN (Report 5).

methods.name: signInReturnsTokenAndUser
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-001: valid credentials return a token and the contract user shape.

methods.name: wrongPasswordAndUnknownEmailLookTheSame
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-002: wrong password and unknown email get the same generic answer.

methods.name: signOutRevokesToken
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-003: me works with the token; after sign-out the same token gets 401.

methods.name: roleRulesAreEnforced
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-004: no token → 401; a student calling an Admin endpoint → 403.

methods.name: accountLocksAfterMaxFailedAttempts
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-005 (boundary): the 5th wrong password locks the account, even for the right password.

methods.name: invalidBodyReturnsFieldErrors
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-006 (negative): body validation returns field messages.

methods.name: termsAreListed
methods.comment: TC-CFG-001: published Terms with string ids, ISO dates and the list total.

methods.name: forgotPasswordIsSilent
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-007: forgot password never reveals whether the email exists.

methods.name: rememberIsOptional
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-008: "remember" may be left out (Jackson 3 would reject a missing primitive).

methods.name: googleNeedsExactlyOneOfCodeAndCredential
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-009 (negative): Google sign-in needs exactly one of code and credential.

methods.name: googleRedirectOnlyToTheSignInPage
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-052 (negative): the redirect flow is accepted only for the web app's own sign-in page; any other address is refused before Google is asked.

methods.name: googleDisabledWithoutConfiguration
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-010: without Google configuration both flows answer 503 GOOGLE_SIGN_IN_DISABLED.

methods.name: noDefaultSpringUser
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-028 (security): Spring's default in-memory user is not created, so no generated password is written to the log; sign-in goes only through CampusStay's accounts.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.BlockSettingsIT
comment: Block Manager › Block settings, inside the Admin limits (TC-CFG-014, 015, 031).

methods.name: readAndSave
methods.comment: TC-CFG-014: the Block's settings and the Admin limits; the Manager saves a change, which is audited.

methods.name: rejectsValuesOutsideTheLimits
methods.comment: TC-CFG-015 (negative): values outside the Admin limits or out of order are named per field; Manager only.

methods.name: savesHouseRulesWithoutDeskHours
methods.comment: TC-CFG-031: the house rules are saved without desk hours (review R-08: no longer asked); the stored desk hours stay as they were.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.BlockStaffIT
comment: Block Manager › Staff: who works in the Block, what they handle, duty, account requests (TC-AUTH-019…021).

methods.name: list
methods.comment: Block A's staff (a Manager sees every Block, ADR-19).

methods.name: listsTheBlocksStaff
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-019: the Block's staff with titles, handles, Blocks, open work and duty; the summary.

methods.name: updatesHandlesAndDuty
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-020: a Manager sets what a Staff member of any Block handles and their duty (ADR-19).

methods.name: staffStartAndEndTheirShift
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-057: a Staff member reads their own duty, request types and workload, and starts or ends their shift (A-60); the change is audited, and students may not use it.

methods.name: requestsANewAccount
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-021: the Manager asks Admin for a new account in the Block; one waiting request per email.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.DemoResetIT
comment: Admin › System › Demo data on a demo server ({@code DEMO_TOOLS=true}). The test seed is not the base data, so the reset itself stops at its base-data check; the stages are loaded and checked against the base data locally.

methods.name: showsStagesScenariosAndFiles
methods.comment: TC-CFG-026: the Admin sees the stages, the scenario accounts and the sample files; nobody else does.

methods.name: resetChecksStageConfirmationAndBaseData
methods.comment: TC-CFG-027: a reset needs a known stage and RESET typed, and refuses a database without the base data.

methods.name: downloadsSampleFiles
methods.comment: TC-CFG-028: the sample files download as CSV with a byte-order mark; an unknown one is 404.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.DeskIT
comment: The Check-in and Check-out desk (TC-ASG-020…023, 045, 046). Each test allocates its own students.

methods.name: allocate
methods.comment: Applies, pays the Deposits, approves, runs and commits Block A: the students hold Beds, Balance unpaid.

methods.name: checkInNeedsBalanceAndUtilityDeposit
methods.comment: TC-ASG-020: the Balance includes the Utility Deposit; until it is paid the desk blocks check-in; then the student checks in with the hand-over items, once only.

methods.name: deskIsScoped
methods.comment: TC-ASG-021 (scope): another Block's Staff do not find the student, every Manager does (ADR-19); students and the Admin have no desk.

methods.name: checkOutSettlesTheDeposit
methods.comment: TC-ASG-022: check-out settles the Utility Deposit: the share since the Room's last reading, the damage charge, the refund to the Manager; the Bed is free again, the figures stay as settled and the Room's door code must change.

methods.name: finalReadingsRoomByRoom
methods.comment: TC-ASG-046: the desk enters the final meter readings Room by Room, typed or from the XLSX template, before the leavers come: each Room's reading goes to the check-out drafts of its leavers; a Room without leavers in the user's Blocks or a reading below the Room's last one is reported and not saved.

methods.name: shortfallIsInvoiced
methods.comment: TC-ASG-023: when the charges exceed the Utility Deposit, the rest is invoiced to the student.

methods.name: checkOutRecordsDamagePerItem
methods.comment: TC-ASG-045: check-out records the damage of each furniture item of the Room (spec §6.16): the damage charge is their sum, a damaged item becomes Broken with the reason in its history, an item of another Room is refused; the list shows the Term's check-out date and whether a leaver is past it.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.DevicesIT
comment: FCM device tokens and push after commit (TC-NTF-020, 021); FCM itself is a recording stand-in.

methods.name: registerAndUnregister
methods.comment: TC-NTF-020: register, register again, unregister; the token is stored by hash and validated.

methods.name: pushAfterCommit
methods.comment: TC-NTF-021: a notification is pushed to the user's devices after commit; an expired token is disabled.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.DoorCodeIT
comment: Door codes: set, confirm, view, import, rotation and the student's code (ADR-23, spec §6.8; TC-INV-019…023).

methods.name: proposesConfirmsAndReveals
methods.comment: TC-INV-019: Staff draw a random code, read it to set the lock, confirm it, and it becomes the Room's code; the database holds it encrypted and every view is in the Audit Log.

methods.name: refusesWrongCodes
methods.comment: TC-INV-020 (validation, scope, permission): codes are 6 new digits; other Blocks and other roles are refused.

methods.name: importsCodes
methods.comment: TC-INV-021: a CSV of Rooms and codes is checked line by line; a correct file proposes every code at once.

methods.name: rotatesTheCodeWhenSomeoneLeaves
methods.comment: TC-INV-022: when a resident leaves a Room its code must change: a task opens once, the Block's Staff are told, and confirming the new code closes it and tells the remaining residents (never the code itself).

methods.name: showsTheStudentTheirCode
methods.comment: TC-INV-023: a student whose Balance is paid and whose check-in start has come waits for the Room's code; once Staff confirm it, it is released to them (spec §6.8): they are told (never the code), see it and become a resident; without a Bed there is nothing to show.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.EscalationIT
comment: Requests past their timers escalate to the Block Manager, who hands them on (TC-REQ-016…018).

methods.name: reportedHoursAgo
methods.comment: Moves the report back in time, as if it had waited that long.

methods.name: maintenanceEscalatesAndIsReassigned
methods.comment: TC-REQ-016: an unassigned request escalates, then passes its timer; the Manager reassigns it once.

methods.name: escalationClosesWhenTheRequestIsAssigned
methods.comment: TC-REQ-017: an escalation closes by itself once the request is back on track.

methods.name: roomChangeEscalatesAndGetsATemporaryBed
methods.comment: TC-REQ-018: an undecided next-Term Room-Change Request escalates; the Manager offers a temporary Bed; Manager only.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.FamilyDayIT
comment: Family Day (ADR-29, contract A-69): Managers organise it for a Block, its residents register guests who each get a pass, the Block's Staff check guests in once and out, the Manager closes it (TC-VIS-001…008).

methods.name: livesIn
methods.comment: A resident (door code released) on a free Bed of the Block, once per class.

methods.name: draft
methods.comment: A Draft for Block A: registration open now, two time slots later today (3 and 10 places).

methods.name: published
methods.comment: Creates and publishes a Family Day; returns its id.

methods.name: slotIsNow
methods.comment: Moves the time slot to now (it started 10 minutes ago, ends in an hour): the day of the Family Day.

methods.name: slotsAreOver
methods.comment: Moves every time slot of the Family Day into the past.

methods.name: managerCreatesAndPublishes
methods.comment: TC-VIS-001: a Manager creates a Draft (fields checked; Staff may not), publishes it and the Block's residents are told; a published Family Day cannot be edited; Staff of another Block cannot read it.

methods.name: residentRegistersGuestsWithTheirOwnPasses
methods.comment: TC-VIS-002: a resident registers guests for one time slot and each guest gets their own pass; guests are checked (a child comes with an adult, at most the Family Day's number); one registration per student; students of other Blocks and students who live nowhere cannot see or register.

methods.name: timeSlotCapacityIsNeverExceeded
methods.comment: TC-VIS-003: a time slot never takes more guests than its places: a registration larger than what is left is refused, and two students racing for the last place get it once.

methods.name: deskChecksAGuestInOnceAndOut
methods.comment: TC-VIS-004: at the desk, Staff of the Block scan a pass, check the identity paper and let the guest in once; the guest leaves and the pass no longer works; Staff of another Block cannot use it; an unknown pass is refused and written to the Audit Log.

methods.name: samePassScannedTwiceAtOnceChecksInOnce
methods.comment: TC-VIS-005: two desks scanning the same pass at the same moment let the guest in once.

methods.name: overdueGuestsNoShowsAndClosing
methods.comment: TC-VIS-006: after the time slots a guest still inside is Overdue and a guest who never came is a No-show; the Manager cannot close the day while someone is inside; Staff close the visit with a note; closing records the No-shows and the counts.

methods.name: cancellationsFreePlacesAndRevokePasses
methods.comment: TC-VIS-007: a student cancels before their time slot and the places come back; a Manager cancels a registration with a reason and the student is told; cancelling the Family Day cancels every registration, the passes stop working and the students are told.

methods.name: registrationClosesOnTime
methods.comment: TC-VIS-008: registration closes at its time: a published Family Day whose registration is over takes nobody.

methods.name: overdueGuestsAreRemindedAndConfirmedBeforeCheckOut
methods.comment: TC-VIS-009 (contract A-71): guests still inside after their time slot. The desk reminds every student concerned in one batch (one notification each, sent again while guests stay); a student confirms their guests are safe; Staff check out a confirmed guest and must wait for the others; nothing to remind or confirm before the slot ends.

methods.name: statisticsAfterTheFamilyDay
methods.comment: TC-VIS-010 (contract A-71): Family Day statistics. The Block's Staff, Managers and the Admin read the figures of a Family Day (registrations, guests registered and arrived, time slots, the overdue procedure) and the overview of the Family Days that are over; Staff of another Block and students cannot; a Draft has none.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.FinanceIT
comment: Block Finance: overdue Invoices and reminders, figures, refunds (TC-BIL-020, 021, 040).

methods.name: overdueAndReminders
methods.comment: TC-BIL-020: an unpaid charge past its due date becomes Overdue (the student is told) while a Balance past its deadline does not (it is forfeited instead, spec §6.6); a Manager sees the charge with the days overdue and sends a reminder, in-app and by email.

methods.name: refundDecisions
methods.comment: TC-BIL-021: refunds wait for the Block Manager; rejecting needs a note; the student is told.

methods.name: refundAccountReminderAndStudentRefunds
methods.comment: TC-BIL-040: a refund lists its rule's percentage apart from its amount (R-21); a Manager reminds a student without a refund account to enter it, once a day, not once it is entered (R-19); the student sees their refunds on Payments (R-24).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.FurnitureIT
comment: Staff and Manager › Furniture: items, Block stores, moves and transfers (spec §6.19; TC-INV-015…018). Block A's Rooms have the items their classes require and its store holds two fridges and an air conditioner.

methods.name: listsItemsInScope
methods.comment: TC-INV-015 (scope): items of the Blocks in scope, with counts per status and filters; other Blocks are refused.

methods.name: registersItems
methods.comment: TC-INV-016 (permission): Managers register items with new asset codes; Staff cannot; the input is checked.

methods.name: movesAndTransfersItems
methods.comment: TC-INV-017 (business rule): Staff move items inside their Block now (status follows the place, the Room's conformance changes); moving to another Block is a Manager's transfer, planned and then done by Staff; a planned move can also be cancelled.

methods.name: stockAndPersonalItemsFollowTheirBed
methods.comment: TC-INV-028 (business rule): the stock per Block counts the store, the Rooms and broken items and values the store at the types' real prices; another Block is refused to Staff. A personal item that leaves its Room loses its Bed and gets a free Bed of the Room it is moved back to.

methods.name: changesStatus
methods.comment: TC-INV-018 (validation): status changes follow the place, Disposed is final, and every change is recorded.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.HandoverIT
comment: The check-in inventory (room handover): the four conditions, the door code at the start, the comparison with the Room's record kept from the student, Staff's review and visit, the deadline, and the furniture charges at check-out (TC-ASG-053…059).

methods.name: tearDown
methods.comment: The students of this class are reused between tests: their rows and the Rooms' codes go after each test.

methods.name: newcomer
methods.comment: A paid new resident of the Room (not living there yet) whose late arrival is approved until after today.

methods.name: answers
methods.comment: Every item answered with the condition, and the meters.

methods.name: startsOnlyWhenTheFourConditionsHold
methods.comment: TC-ASG-053: without the Room's door code the start is refused and the condition says why; once the code is set the student starts the inventory, receives the code and is a resident, but Utility does not count yet.

methods.name: deskWaitsForTheCheckInInventory
methods.comment: TC-ASG-060: while the check-in inventory is on, the desk does not check in a new resident who has not filed it; once the inventory is final the student is checked in by it.

methods.name: studentNeverSeesTheRoomsRecord
methods.comment: TC-ASG-054: the student's view never carries the Room's record nor the comparison, and the Staff endpoints are closed to students.

methods.name: matchingInventoryIsFinalAtOnce
methods.comment: TC-ASG-055: an inventory that matches the Room's record is final at once: Utility counts from the student's reading and the desk check-in is recorded; a reading lower than the Room's is refused.

methods.name: majorDifferenceIsCheckedInTheRoom
methods.comment: TC-ASG-056: a meter far above the Room's record is a major difference: Staff ask for a visit, record what they find and send it; the student agrees with a comment and the inventory is final (no dispute state).

methods.name: deadlineClosesTheInventory
methods.comment: TC-ASG-057: a draft past its deadline becomes final with the Room's record; Utility counts from the code.

methods.name: personalItemIsChargedByCondition
methods.comment: TC-ASG-058: at check-out a personal item Good at check-in and Damaged now costs its price × the share the Mostly damaged level loses (50 %); the check-out waits for the student's agreement on the app.

methods.name: sharedDamageNeedsTheStudentsAcknowledgement
methods.comment: TC-ASG-059: damage to a shared item is charged only once the student acknowledges it; a declined one is not.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.InspectionIT
comment: Inspections: checklists (Admin), schedules (Block Manager) and runs (Staff) (TC-MNT-004…007).

methods.name: checklistsAreVersioned
methods.comment: TC-MNT-004: the seeded checklist; a Draft is published as v1; editing publishes v2 and keeps v1 as Replaced.

methods.name: scheduleAndRun
methods.comment: TC-MNT-005: a schedule starts its first run at once and notifies residents; Staff record the Rooms with their own checks (people, furniture), a failed item creates a Maintenance Request with the severity's priority (a failed furniture item one that names it); the run is submitted; the job starts the next.

methods.name: staffListTheirRunsWithPhotos
methods.comment: TC-MNT-010: Staff see every run assigned to them (not only the first), open one by its code, and add photos of a furniture item and of the meters like a student's check-in inventory; Managers list every Block's schedules and runs, each with its Block, without the editor options.

methods.name: archivingPausesSchedules
methods.comment: TC-MNT-006: archiving a checklist pauses its schedules, which cannot resume until another is published.

methods.name: permissions
methods.comment: TC-MNT-007 (permission): schedules are the Managers', for every Block (ADR-19); runs need Staff.

methods.name: roomChecks
methods.comment: The Room's own checks of the run above (spec §6.19): the Room is not done until the people count and each furniture item are answered; a failed furniture item creates a Furniture Maintenance Request naming the item, and the item's history keeps the repair.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.InventoryIT
comment: Admin › Buildings and Staff/Manager › Inventory (TC-INV-NNN).

methods.name: listsBuildingsAndFloors
methods.comment: TC-INV-001: Blocks with their Floors, Room counts per Room Type and closed Rooms.

methods.name: createsBlockAndGeneratesRooms
methods.comment: TC-INV-002: a new Block gets the standard layout; generating again adds nothing; bad ranges are refused.

methods.name: structureFollowsBlockScope
methods.comment: TC-INV-003 (scope): Staff see only their Blocks; a Block outside the scope is refused.

methods.name: showsFloorWithOutOfServiceRoom
methods.comment: TC-INV-004: a Floor's Rooms and Beds with the out-of-service details.

methods.name: occupiedRoomIsProtected
methods.comment: TC-INV-005 (business rule): an occupied Room cannot go out of service, its Block cannot change gender and its Room Type cannot change Beds; the occupant shows on the Bed.

methods.name: outOfServiceAndBack
methods.comment: TC-INV-006: out of service and back, with the reason label, who set it, and the Audit Log.

methods.name: studentsCannotSeeInventory
methods.comment: TC-INV-007 (permission): students cannot see the inventory; unknown Rooms are 404.

methods.name: generatesRoomsOfAChosenClass
methods.comment: TC-INV-012: bulk generation gives the new Rooms the Room Class chosen for them (the Floor keeps it as the class of its later Rooms); each Floor lists the classes its Rooms have, which are set per Room from then on.

methods.name: readsRoomCodeList
methods.comment: TC-INV-025: a Room code list (CSV, with or without its header) gives the Rooms and the codes no Room has.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.LateCheckInIT
comment: Late check-ins: asked online or recorded at the desk, decided by a Manager (TC-ASG-030, 031, 037).

methods.name: approvedLateCheckIn
methods.comment: TC-ASG-030: Staff record the request with evidence; the Block Manager approves a deadline, after which the desk lets the student check in even though the Term's window is closed.

methods.name: rejectedLateCheckIn
methods.comment: TC-ASG-031: a rejection needs a reason; every Manager sees the request (ADR-19); a student has one late check-in per Term, so the desk cannot record another after the rejection.

methods.name: studentAsksOnline
methods.comment: TC-ASG-037: the student asks online with a reason, the day and an evidence file, up to the check-in end plus late_check_in.max_days; the Managers are told; one request per Term, also after the decision; a Manager approves at most that day.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.LayeringTest
comment: Calls go one way, controller → service → repository / entity (ADR-17, architecture §5): controllers never reach the database themselves, and nothing below the controllers depends on them.

methods.name: controllersGoThroughServices
methods.comment: Controllers never import repositories, entities or Spring JDBC: they call services only.

methods.name: lowerLayersDoNotDependOnControllers
methods.comment: Nothing below the controllers (services, repositories, entities, DTOs, events, common) imports a controller.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.LocaleIT
comment: Two languages (ADR-25): the account's language, error messages and notifications in Vietnamese or English.

methods.name: accountLanguage
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-036: the user carries the account's language; the account changes it; only vi and en are accepted.

methods.name: errorsInTheRequestLanguage
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-037: with Accept-Language: vi errors and field messages are Vietnamese, the code unchanged; English without.

methods.name: notificationsInBothLanguages
methods.comment: TC-NTF-038: a notification keeps both texts; the Notification Center shows the reader's language.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.MaintenanceIT
comment: Maintenance Requests from the student's report to the confirmed fix (TC-MNT-001…003).

methods.name: livesIn
methods.comment: The student holds the Bed and has checked in (the desk is tested in DeskIT).

methods.name: studentReportsAndFollows
methods.comment: TC-MNT-001: a checked-in student reports with photos and follows the request; the form is validated.

methods.name: staffWorkTheRequest
methods.comment: TC-MNT-002: Staff of the Block assign, plan the visit, post updates and resolve; the student is notified, reopens once and confirms the fix. Photos open through signed links.

methods.name: personInChargeChangesTheStatus
methods.comment: TC-MNT-009: only the person in charge changes the status; another Staff member of the Block takes the request over first (recorded in its history), and a Manager may act on any request.

methods.name: queueIsScoped
methods.comment: TC-MNT-003: the queue is scoped: another Block's Staff neither see nor count the request; Managers do (ADR-19).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.MessagingIT
comment: Admin › Notification templates and Send email (TC-NTF-030…033).

methods.name: editsTemplates
methods.comment: TC-NTF-030: templates with their variables and sample values; the push limit and unknown variables.

methods.name: sendsATestToTheAdmin
methods.comment: TC-NTF-031: a test sends the unsaved text, with sample values, to the signed-in Admin.

methods.name: previewsAnEmail
methods.comment: TC-NTF-032: options leave system emails out; the preview counts the group and renders the first email.

methods.name: sendsAnEmail
methods.comment: TC-NTF-033: sending queues one email per student (and the in-app notice with push); validation; Admin only.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.MeterIT
comment: Monthly meter readings and Utility Invoices (TC-BIL-023…026).

methods.name: residentsWithLastMonth
methods.comment: Two residents of a Room, and last month's closed reading of that Room (1,000 kWh, 40 m³; it used 100 kWh).

methods.name: periodsAndReadings
methods.comment: TC-BIL-023: the current month opens on first use; Rooms with residents wait for a reading.

methods.name: readingRules
methods.comment: TC-BIL-024: a reading may not go back; an unusual jump waits for a confirmation.

methods.name: importCsv
methods.comment: TC-BIL-025: a CSV import checks every line before it saves any.

methods.name: templateFilledInExcel
methods.comment: TC-BIL-039: the template lists the period's Rooms with their previous values; filled in Excel with Vietnamese headers it is read back, and Rooms left blank are skipped, not refused.

methods.name: closeIssuesUtilityInvoices
methods.comment: TC-BIL-026: closing the month issues each resident's Utility Invoice with its breakdown; then it is read-only.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.NextTermRequestIT
comment: Next-Term requests besides room changes and swaps (spec §6.10, §6.11, D-04, D-30): extensions (approved at once when the student may extend, otherwise by Staff) and the end of the stay; the Room Class change of a Room with the consent of every continuing resident and the furniture check; every open request of the window in one list, decided in bulk (TC-REQ-019…021).

methods.name: extensionsAndEndOfStay
methods.comment: TC-REQ-019: an extension in the Stay's last Term is approved at once (the Bed is kept, the Stay commits more Terms); with an overdue Invoice it waits for Staff, who decide it with a note to reject; the length is checked; the end of the stay releases the next-Term Bed at once; after the request deadline nothing can be filed.

methods.name: roomClassChange
methods.comment: TC-REQ-020: a Room Class change of a Room for the next Term: every other continuing resident must agree (one in the Stay's last Term is not asked); Staff cannot approve before; the furniture check reserves the missing items of the Block store; the Room's class changes for the next Term only, and the next-Term price follows it; a refusal cancels a change; Staff of another Block see nothing.

methods.name: windowListAndBulk
methods.comment: TC-REQ-021: the requests window in one list (room changes, swaps, Room Class changes, extensions), oldest first; a bulk decision decides each one in its own transaction and reports those it could not (a change still waiting for consent); a bulk rejection needs a reason; Staff of another Block see nothing.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.NotificationsIT
comment: Notification Center (TC-NTF-NNN). Each test uses its own student so the unread counts do not mix.

methods.name: listsLatestWithUnreadCount
methods.comment: TC-NTF-001: newest first, with the unread count and string ids; {@code limit} caps the items.

methods.name: marksReadOnlyOwnNotifications
methods.comment: TC-NTF-002: mark one read (twice is fine), then all; someone else's notification is 404.

methods.name: requiresSignIn
methods.comment: TC-NTF-003 (negative): signed-in users only.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.OperationalMoveIT
comment: Operational moves (spec §6.13, D-14, D-31): Staff inside their Blocks or a Manager move a student for a recorded reason at no charge; a resident's move cuts both Rooms' meters, rotates the old Room's code and takes the next-Term Bed along; once the next-Term fees are issued only a Manager moves a next-Term Bed: an unpaid fee is issued again, a paid one allows only a Bed of the same price (TC-ASG-043, 044).

methods.name: staffMoveAResident
methods.comment: TC-ASG-043: Staff move a resident to another Room of their Block for a reason: both meters are read, the old Room's code must change, the next-Term Bed follows, nothing is charged; the student is told; the moves list shows it; validation, other Blocks and students are refused.

methods.name: frozenAfterTheFees
methods.comment: TC-ASG-044: after the next-Term fees are issued, Staff may no longer move a next-Term Bed; a Manager moves an unpaid one and its fee is void and issued again for the new Bed; a paid fee allows only a Bed of the same price.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.OperationsIT
comment: Change Specification v2 phase 7 "Operations": SLA deadlines and furniture on Maintenance Requests, the Room hub, the Term hub's requests window, staff workload next to the routing rules and the back-office search.

methods.name: slaDeadlineAndFurnitureItem
methods.comment: TC-MNT-008: a new Maintenance Request gets its SLA deadline from the Block's timer (urgent sooner than normal) and may name a furniture item of the Room, which the queue and the detail show; the item's history keeps the repair, reported and resolved; an item of another Room is refused.

methods.name: roomHub
methods.comment: TC-INV-024: the Room hub lists the Room's residents, Maintenance Requests, meter readings and inspections next to its class, furniture and door code; Staff of another Block may not open it.

methods.name: search
methods.comment: TC-RPT-013: the back-office search finds students by code or name, Rooms with or without the dash and request codes inside the user's Blocks; Staff of another Block find neither the Room nor its resident; short queries find nothing and students may not search.

methods.name: routingShowsWorkload
methods.comment: TC-REQ-022: the routing rules page lists the Block's staff with their open and finished work.

methods.name: termHubTransition
methods.comment: TC-RPT-014: the Term hub shows the requests window once it opened (open requests, Continuing residents, next-Term fees issued and paid, Beds released) and nothing before.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.PasswordFlowIT
comment: Password reset (from the emailed link) and password change, against a real PostgreSQL. The raw reset token is only in the email, so tests read it from the notification outbox row. Each test uses its own seed account. Test case IDs follow TC-AUTH-NNN (Report 5).

methods.name: resetChangesPasswordAndRevokesSessions
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-022: reset sets the new password, the old one fails and every earlier session is signed out.

methods.name: resetLinkCannotBeReused
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-023 (negative): a reset link works only once.

methods.name: resetRejectsWeakPasswordAndKeepsLink
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-024 (negative): a weak new password is refused and the link stays usable.

methods.name: changeRejectsWrongCurrentPassword
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-025 (negative): a wrong current password is a field error and changes nothing.

methods.name: changeKeepsCurrentSessionAndRevokesOthers
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-026: change keeps the current session, signs out the others and the new password works.

methods.name: changeRejectsWeakPassword
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-027 (negative): change refuses a weak new password and keeps the old one.

methods.name: requestResetToken
methods.comment: Asks for a reset link and reads the raw token from the email queued in the same transaction.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.PaymentClaimIT
comment: Payment claims (ADR-22, spec §6.7): "I have transferred", the Managers' queue, confirmations one by one or in bulk, rejections that give the remaining time back and cancel after too many, reminders and the hourly summary (TC-BIL-032…036).

methods.name: depositDueIn
methods.comment: Moves both deadlines of a Deposit (the Application's window and its Invoice) by SQL.

methods.name: claimStopsTheClockAndBulkConfirmationPays
methods.comment: TC-BIL-032: the claim waits for a Manager and stops the Deposit window (the Application does not expire); the queue lists it with the count and total; a bulk confirmation pays each Invoice at the time of its claim, one audit entry each, and the Applications are submitted; unknown Invoices and claims without their transfer receipt (R-23) are skipped.

methods.name: rejectionsGiveTimeBackThenCancel
methods.comment: TC-BIL-033: a rejection needs a reason; the Invoice is Unpaid again and the deadline continues with the time that was left (at least payment.rejected_claim_min_hours); the student is told; a second rejection cancels the Deposit and the Application expires.

methods.name: claimRules
methods.comment: TC-BIL-034 (validation, permission): one claim at a time; a paid or void Invoice and a Deposit past its deadline cannot be claimed; a student cannot cancel while a claim waits; only Managers see the queue and decide; an empty selection is refused; Invoices without a claim are skipped.

methods.name: debtsAreNeverCancelled
methods.comment: TC-BIL-035: a Utility Invoice is a debt: a claim made after its due date leaves the date as it was, a rejection returns it to Overdue and rejections never cancel it.

methods.name: remindersAndHourlySummary
methods.comment: TC-BIL-036: Balance reminders go out 3 and 1 days before the deadline, once each, never for a claim waiting; the Managers hear once an hour how many claims wait.

methods.name: utilityInvoice
methods.comment: A Utility Invoice of the student's Allocation, due {@code dueIn} from now.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.PaymentDeskIT
comment: Staff › Payments: the scoped list with its summary and manual confirmation (TC-BIL-010…012).

methods.name: scopedListWithSummary
methods.comment: TC-BIL-010: Invoices with filters and the summary; every Manager sees every Block, Staff do not (ADR-19).

methods.name: manualConfirmation
methods.comment: TC-BIL-011: a Manager confirms one Invoice with the bank reference and its receipt (required, R-23), even a transfer the student did not claim (the claim is recorded in the Manager's name); the Application is submitted; a second confirmation is refused; Staff and students may not confirm (ADR-19, ADR-22).

methods.name: manualConfirmationRules
methods.comment: TC-BIL-012: receipt files are sniffed; a void Invoice (its Application cancelled) cannot be confirmed.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.PaymentsIT
comment: Student Invoices, the payment page with its VietQR image and "I have transferred", and privacy (TC-BIL-001, 006).

methods.name: depositInvoiceAndPaymentPage
methods.comment: TC-BIL-001: the Deposit Invoice in the list, its detail and the VietQR payment page; the QR can be refreshed.

methods.name: invoicesArePrivate
methods.comment: TC-BIL-006 (permission): another student's Invoice is 404; the Admin may read it.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.PostgresTestcontainer
comment: One PostgreSQL 17 container for integration tests (needs Docker).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.ReconciliationIT
comment: Enrollment reconciliation (spec §6.12, D-28): the enrolled list or a leavers list of a Term against its residents, continuing residents and applicants, in four groups; each item of groups 1–2 is resolved with a note, "Not enrolled" ending what the student holds in the Term; the next-Term fees wait for it (TC-AUTH-053…055).

methods.name: enrolledListGroups
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-053: the enrolled list of the next Term: a continuing resident who graduated (group 1, the directory updated: group 4), a continuing resident missing from the list (group 2), an unknown code (group 3), another student's changed status (group 4); the template; Managers upload, the Admin reads, Staff may not; a file without a student code column is refused.

methods.name: resolveItems
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-054: resolving: a note is required; "Not enrolled" releases the student's Bed for the next Term (told in the app); "Enrolled" keeps everything; an item is resolved once; then nothing blocks the next-Term fees.

methods.name: leaversDuringTheTerm
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-055: a leavers list during a Term: a resident who withdrew gets a termination (reason Not enrolled); an applicant's Application is rejected and the paid Deposit refunded by the rule "Not enrolled" (waiting for a Manager); students not on a leavers list are not questioned.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.RefundAccountIT
comment: The bank account a student's refunds are paid to (A-62; TC-AUTH-058).

methods.name: studentKeepsTheirRefundAccount
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-058: a student reads and saves their refund account; the number keeps its digits only, the bank is chosen from the list by its BIN and the student accepts responsibility for the account (R-22), each field is checked, and only students have one.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.RegistrationPeriodIT
comment: The registration period card of the board and its details (spec §6.5; TC-CFG-023).

methods.name: cardAndDetails
methods.comment: TC-CFG-023: the card shows the Term open for registration with its countdown, places and lowest price; its details list the timeline and every price with its Deposit, the furniture its Room Class requires and the Beds of the student's gender (no Rooms); a Draft has no details.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.RenewalFlow
comment: Helpers for the Term transition tests: Term N is {@link ApplyFlow}'s test Term (stay January–April 2031), N+1 a Term after it whose requests window opened an hour ago (renewal milestones relative to now, so the tests do not depend on the date) with its own prices, 10 % above the defaults.

methods.name: openNextTerm
methods.comment: Publishes N+1 once; its registration opens later, the requests window is open until M3 in two days.

methods.name: reset
methods.comment: A clean requests window for each test of a class (they share one database): the window is not opened yet, the milestones are back to their defaults, and the Allocations, Stays and open requests of earlier tests are closed (cancelled, so the turnover never counts them as leavers).

methods.name: nextPrice
methods.comment: The next Term's price per Bed of a Room Type × Room Class.

methods.name: resident
methods.comment: A resident of N (holding the door code) whose Stay commits {@code terms} Terms: 1 = N is its last Term.

methods.name: milestone
methods.comment: Moves a milestone of N+1 to {@code interval} from now ({@code -1 minute}, {@code 2 days}).

methods.name: allocationOf
methods.comment: The student's active Allocation of a Term, as a string id.

methods.name: feeOf
methods.comment: The code of the student's live next-Term fee.

methods.name: overdueUtility
methods.comment: An overdue Utility Invoice of the student in Term N.

methods.name: enrolled
methods.comment: CSV of an enrolled list: every code given is Enrolled.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.RenewalIT
comment: The Term transition (spec §5.1, §6.10): the requests window opens with a next-Term Allocation for every resident (continuing, or awaiting extension in the Stay's last Term), M3 releases the Beds not extended, a Manager issues the next-Term fees once the requests are decided and the enrolled list reconciled (one fee per continuing resident, never twice), M7 releases the Beds whose fee is unpaid, and the turnover hands the next Term's door codes to the paid residents (TC-ASG-038…042).

methods.name: windowOpens
methods.comment: TC-ASG-038: M2 opens the requests window once: a resident with Terms left keeps the Bed as continuing, one in the Stay's last Term as awaiting extension; a student not living in the Room yet and a terminated resident get none. My Room shows the next Term with its price, the students are told, Staff and Managers read the overview, and the new students' assignment of the next Term waits for the request deadline.

methods.name: notExtendedAtTheDeadline
methods.comment: TC-ASG-039: M3 closes filing: a Bed still awaiting extension is released (the student is told in-app and by email, with the day to check out), a continuing one stays; the overview counts the ending.

methods.name: nextTermFees
methods.comment: TC-ASG-040: Issue next-Term fees: the preview names what blocks them (filing still open, no reconciliation); once filing closed and the enrolled list is reconciled a Manager issues one fee per continuing resident = 100 % of the next Term's price of the Bed (no Deposit); issuing again charges nobody twice; leavers receive the end-of-stay notice; Staff may not issue; the fee cannot be claimed while Utility is overdue; paid, the Stay counts the next Term.

methods.name: unpaidFeesReleaseTheBed
methods.comment: TC-ASG-041: M7: a next-Term fee unpaid at its deadline with no claim waiting is void and its Bed released (nothing kept); a fee whose claim waits for a Manager keeps the Bed.

methods.name: turnover
methods.comment: TC-ASG-042: the turnover: from the next Term's check-in start a paid continuing resident receives the Room's code and lives in the next Term (the current Term's Allocation ends); a mover's old Room needs a new code; the turnover list shows leavers, movers and the Rooms whose residents change, and Staff record their meter readings.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.ReportIT
comment: Dashboards, reports and exports, read from the reporting views (TC-RPT-001…008, TC-RPT-010, TC-RPT-011).

methods.name: staffDashboard
methods.comment: TC-RPT-001: Staff dashboard: the review queue, Rooms out of service, the Block's Beds, what needs attention.

methods.name: managerDashboard
methods.comment: TC-RPT-002: Block Manager dashboard: occupancy by floor, the SLA rate and target, what is waiting.

methods.name: dashboardsAgreeWithFinance
methods.comment: TC-RPT-015: the Manager's and the Admin's dashboards report the money of Collections and refunds (a paid Deposit without a Bed included) with what is still owed, residents apart from held Beds, the continuing residents the funnel leaves out, the Staff work a Manager decides, and the values of each attention line.

methods.name: approvalCounts
methods.comment: TC-RPT-003: the Manager's approval counts; Staff may not see them.

methods.name: adminDashboard
methods.comment: TC-RPT-004: Admin dashboard: the Term, people, the funnel, Blocks, configuration checks and integrations.

methods.name: occupancyReport
methods.comment: TC-RPT-005: occupancy by Block, Room Type and Room Class; capacity leaves Rooms out of service out.

methods.name: financialReport
methods.comment: TC-RPT-006: money per Block; Deposits of students without a Bed have a row of their own.

methods.name: blockReport
methods.comment: TC-RPT-007: the Block report counts check-ins per week and who has not checked in yet.

methods.name: pastTermReports
methods.comment: TC-RPT-010: a Term that has ended still reports who lived there (Allocations ended by check-out, not by a room change), and a refunded Deposit without a Bed counts in the row of its own.

methods.name: dashboardsBeforeTheFirstTerm
methods.comment: TC-RPT-011: before the first Term is published the dashboards and approval counts answer with empty figures (the Admin's checks still list what to set up); an unknown Term and the reports still answer 404.

methods.name: exports
methods.comment: TC-RPT-008: exports are CSV files with the screen's columns, written to the Audit Log; scope and permissions.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.ResidenceIT
comment: Residence (ADR-23, spec §6.6, §6.8, §11.5): the door code released once the Balance is paid, the check-in start has come and the Room's code is confirmed; Bed states on the room map; the forfeit of an unpaid Balance (TC-ASG-032…034).

methods.name: bedState
methods.comment: The state of the student's Bed on the room map of its Floor.

methods.name: doorCodeIsReleasedToPaidResidents
methods.comment: TC-ASG-032: assigned and unpaid (yellow); paid but before the check-in start, then without a Room code, the student waits (no code); Staff confirm the Room's code and it is released: the student is a resident (orange), is told and sees the code; a student who pays later receives the current code at once.

methods.name: unpaidBalanceIsForfeited
methods.comment: TC-ASG-033 (business rule): a Balance past its deadline without a claim is forfeited: the Allocation is cancelled, the Balance void, the Application Forfeited, the Deposit kept by the rule "Balance not paid" (a 0 % rule records no refund; a 10 % rule one refund, never two) and the student told; a claim waiting keeps the Bed, and so does a later Balance deadline a Manager chose when approving a late check-in, which may not pass the arrival day (the Balance is paid before check-in).

methods.name: rejectedClaimsCancelTheBalance
methods.comment: TC-ASG-034: a Balance whose claims are rejected twice is cancelled with its Allocation (spec §6.7).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.RoomChangeIT
comment: Next-Term Room-Change Requests (spec §6.10, D-14): a continuing resident asks during the requests window, Staff of the Block decide with a free matching Bed of the next Term; the student moves there next Term and pays its price then, so nothing is charged or credited now (TC-REQ-001…003).

methods.name: studentAsks
methods.comment: TC-REQ-001: the options show the next-Term Bed and the next Term's prices; a request for another Room Type, one open request per window; validation; a student without a Bed kept for the next Term, or in the last Term of the Stay, cannot ask yet.

methods.name: staffApprove
methods.comment: TC-REQ-002: Staff of the Block approve with a free matching Bed of the next Term: the next-Term Allocation moves there (the student still lives in their Room this Term) and the next-Term fee will be that Bed's price; no Invoice or refund is made; Staff of another Block see nothing; after the next-Term fees the Beds are fixed.

methods.name: staffReject
methods.comment: TC-REQ-003: a rejection needs a listed reason; the student sees it; students may not decide.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.RoomClassIT
comment: Manager › Room Classes: the Room Class of each Room per Term (ADR-24; TC-INV-008…011). The test seed's Fall 2026 is running and Spring 2027 has not started; Block A has the furniture its classes require, Block B none.

methods.name: listsClassesOfTheNextTerm
methods.comment: TC-INV-008: without a Term the list shows the next Term to start, editable, with each Room's class and its furniture conformance; the running Term is shown as fixed. Staff see their Blocks only.

methods.name: setsClassForTheNextTerm
methods.comment: TC-INV-009: a Manager sets Rooms' class for Spring 2027; Fall 2026 keeps the old class, the Rooms and Beds screen and the assignment inputs of Spring 2027 use the new one, conformance shows what the class lacks, and every Room's change is in the Audit Log.

methods.name: keepsClassesWhosePriceIsFixed
methods.comment: TC-INV-010 (business rule): a running Term keeps its classes, and a Room whose Beds are already given for the Term (an Allocation) keeps its class there, so no price already charged changes.

methods.name: refusesWrongRequests
methods.comment: TC-INV-011 (permission, validation): only Managers set classes; students cannot read; bad input is named.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.Round2IT
comment: Round 2 for Waitlisted students: held options, accept, decline and expiry, the Manager's run, withdrawing and the end of the waitlist (TC-APP-020, 021, 024…026).

methods.name: round2Lifecycle
methods.comment: TC-APP-020 and TC-APP-021: three Waitlisted students each get held options in partly filled Rooms. One accepts (Allocated with a Balance), one declines and one does not answer: both are cancelled and their paid Deposits wait as refunds for the Block Manager.

methods.name: waitlisted
methods.comment: Applied, paid and approved, then left without a Bed by Round 1 (as the commit of a Block does).

methods.name: waitlistedStudentWithdraws
methods.comment: TC-APP-025: a waitlisted student sees the open offer, the day the waitlist ends and the refund; withdrawing closes the offer, releases its Beds, cancels the Application and asks a Manager to refund the whole Deposit, whose list shows the student's bank account (A-61, A-62). A plain cancel is refused, and only one's own waitlisted Application can be withdrawn.

methods.name: waitlistEndsWhenCheckInStarts
methods.comment: TC-APP-026: when the Term's check-in starts, a waitlisted Application without an open offer is cancelled with the whole Deposit to refund and the student is told; one with an open offer keeps it until it is answered.

methods.name: managerRunsRound2
methods.comment: TC-APP-024: a Manager runs Round 2 (M8): the Waitlisted students without an open offer get held options on the Term's free Beds, by the rules of the offers made when a Block is approved; students may not run it. The Manager's list shows who is waiting without an offer, then who got one with its options (A-58).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.RoutingIT
comment: Block Manager › Routing rules and escalation timers; new requests follow the rules (TC-REQ-013…015).

methods.name: rulesAndTimers
methods.comment: TC-REQ-013: rules, gaps and timers of the Block; validation; Manager only, in scope.

methods.name: maintenanceFollowsTheRules
methods.comment: TC-REQ-014: a new Maintenance Request goes to the category rule first, else All; off duty → fallback.

methods.name: roomChangesFollowTheRules
methods.comment: TC-REQ-015: a next-Term Room-Change Request goes to the Block's rule and is due at the decision deadline of its requests window (M4, spec §6.18).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.StaffAccountsIT
comment: Manager › Staff accounts: Managers create Staff accounts, choose their Blocks and disable them (spec §3).

methods.name: managerCreatesStaff
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-049: a Manager creates a Staff account for Blocks A and B; it is Invited and gets the set-password email; the email, name and Blocks are checked; Staff cannot create accounts.

methods.name: managerEditsStaff
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-050: a Manager renames a Staff member, changes the title and Blocks, disables the account (signed out) and restores it; Managers and Admins are not Staff accounts (404); an invitation is resent only while Invited.

methods.name: outboxKnowsDemoRecipients
methods.comment: TC-NTF-040: emails remember whether their recipient is a fictional account: a seed account's are, a real person's are not, so only the first may go to the demo mailbox (spec O-3).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.StayFlow
comment: Helpers for tests during the stay: students who hold a Bed, through the real flow or a direct row.

methods.name: livesIn
methods.comment: A Bed without the assignment run, lived in (a resident holding the door code) or not yet (desk and assignment are tested elsewhere).

methods.name: runRound1
methods.comment: Applies for the Room kind and pays the Deposit for each student; a Manager approves them, runs the assignment and commits Block A after moving every conflict to the waitlist (ADR-19).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.StudentAccountsIT
comment: Manager › Students: the student list, the student hub, directory fields, verification and locking (spec §6.2, §11.3).

methods.name: pendingStudent
methods.comment: A student who signed up and sent the form: Pending verification, with a password.

methods.name: listsStudentsWithFilters
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-042: Managers list every student with filters and the count waiting for verification; Staff see only the residents of their Blocks; students may not list.

methods.name: studentHub
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-043: the student hub shows the profile, the account, the Bed, the Applications, Invoices and requests and the history; Staff open only residents of their Blocks; an unknown id is 404.

methods.name: editDirectoryFields
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-044: a Manager corrects directory fields; each is checked; the change is audited; Staff cannot edit.

methods.name: verifyRejectLockUnlock
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-045: a Manager verifies a pending account (the student is told) or rejects it (locked); locking signs the student out until a Manager unlocks the account; a rejected account comes back as pending.

methods.name: pendingAccountCannotApply
methods.comment: TC-APP-022: only a verified account may apply: a pending one sees why and is refused (ADR-26).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.StudentContactIT
comment: A student's own contact details and emergency contacts on My profile (TC-AUTH-060).

methods.name: studentKeepsTheirContacts
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-060: a student edits their phone and personal email, adds emergency contacts up to the limit, edits, reorders and removes them; the first contact is mirrored in the student record that Applications read, each field is checked, another student's contact is not found and only students have contacts.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.StudentImportIT
comment: Manager › Import student list: template, preview, confirm, files (D-07, spec §6.2).

methods.name: accounts
methods.comment: Real students already known: two imported, two who signed up and wait, one the files never list.

methods.name: previewsTheFile
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-046: the template names the columns; an upload is previewed line by line (New, Update, Unchanged, Error with the reason) and counts the students the file leaves out; nothing changes before the confirmation.

methods.name: confirmAppliesTheFile
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-047: confirming creates and updates the accounts, verifies the waiting one that matches, gives a fictional student's code to the real student, marks real students missing from the file Not enrolled (never fictional ones), is written to the Audit Log and cannot run twice.

methods.name: readsWorkbooksAndRefusesBadFiles
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-048: an XLSX workbook is read like a CSV (shared strings, dates as day numbers, Vietnamese headers); a file without a required column or not in UTF-8 is refused; lines can be filtered; Staff may not import.

methods.name: readsMajorsByCodeOrNameAndExplainsCodePrefixes
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-056: a major is read from its code, its English label or its Vietnamese name, the other FPT majors are in the list (V61), and a student-code prefix such as SS put in the major column gets an error that says so; the file is the XLSX the template writer makes.

methods.name: workbook
methods.comment: A one-sheet workbook with Vietnamese headers, a shared string, an inline string and a date as a day number.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.SwapIT
comment: Next-Term Bed swaps (spec §6.10): direct invitations and the swap board of the requests window, Staff decide and a Manager decides last across Blocks; the two next-Term Beds change hands and each student pays the next Term's price of the Bed they get, with no price difference, charge or credit (TC-REQ-010…012).

methods.name: nextRoom
methods.comment: The student's Room in the next Term.

methods.name: directSwap
methods.comment: TC-REQ-010: a direct swap of next-Term Beds: the partner accepts, Staff check and approve, the two next-Term Allocations exchange Beds while both students stay where they live this Term.

methods.name: swapBoard
methods.comment: TC-REQ-011: the swap board of the window: an anonymous post of a next-Term Bed with its next-Term price, a matching request, the swap without any charge or credit; a Bed the post does not want is refused.

methods.name: crossBlockGoesToManager
methods.comment: TC-REQ-012: a swap across Blocks goes from Staff to a Manager, who decides it last; once filing closed and the next-Term fees are issued no swap is carried out any more.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.TermDashboardIT
comment: Manager › Registration › Term dashboard (spec §11.3; TC-RPT-012).

methods.name: termDashboard
methods.comment: TC-RPT-012: the dashboard of a Term shows its milestones in order with their progress, its Applications by status, the places per Room Type × Room Class × gender with the Term's prices, and the Deposits issued; Staff cannot read it and an unknown Term is 404.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.TermRequestIT
comment: Registration-period requests (spec §6.3, D-10, D-11; TC-CFG-016…018): a Manager asks the Admin to open a Term; Admins and the other Managers are told; Managers comment; the Admin sends it back, the Manager sends it again, the Admin rejects it.

methods.name: body
methods.comment: A request for {@code name} staying in 2033 (no other Term uses those dates).

methods.name: managerFilesARequest
methods.comment: TC-CFG-016: a Manager files a request; it is Submitted with its proposal and history, every Admin and every other Manager is notified with a link to the requests list, and the requester is not.

methods.name: refusesInvalidAndDuplicateRequests
methods.comment: TC-CFG-017 (negative): missing fields and an unknown Block are named per field; a second open request for the same Term is refused; Staff and students cannot file or read requests.

methods.name: commentsChangesAndRejection
methods.comment: TC-CFG-018: another Manager comments (the requester and the Admin are told); the Admin asks for changes only with a note; the requester changes and sends it again; the Admin rejects it with a reason; a closed request takes no comment, and every step is in the history.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.TermWizardIT
comment: Admin › Registration periods › Terms: the wizard (spec §6.4, ADR-20; TC-CFG-019…022, 030). Terms of these tests stay in 2032; their registration opens yesterday so students can apply to them.

methods.name: timeline
methods.comment: Registration from yesterday to {@code closes} days from now; Check-in and the stay in {@code year}.

methods.name: prices
methods.comment: Every price line of the wizard, with one line changed.

methods.name: fullDraft
methods.comment: A Draft that goes through every step; returns its id.

methods.name: buildsTheTermFromARequest
methods.comment: TC-CFG-019: the Admin builds the Draft from a Manager's request: it holds the request's dates, Blocks, Rooms and prices, the request is In progress (the Manager is told) and building again opens the same Draft; a price that differs from the request needs a reason, which the request then shows next to the difference.

methods.name: buildsTheOfferAndMoneyTheManagerProposed
methods.comment: TC-CFG-030: the Manager proposes prices as a base price per Room Type and a surcharge per Room Class (BR-10: the request computes each line, rounded up), offers one Room Type and one Room Class, and proposes the Deposit, Utility Deposit, the share for new students and the house rules (review R-02, R-03), starting from the defaults ({@code /term-requests/defaults}). The Draft built from it holds them all; the Admin's different Deposit needs a reason and is listed for the Manager; a surcharge above 500% is refused.

methods.name: timelineFollowsTheRules
methods.comment: TC-CFG-020 (negative): the Timeline step checks spec §5.2 per field: registration closing before it opens, renewal milestones filled in only partly or out of order, Check-in before the Term before is left.

methods.name: publishingFixesTheTerm
methods.comment: TC-CFG-021: a Draft with unsaved steps cannot be published; once every step is saved, publishing fixes the Term's prices, Deposit and rules, tells every Manager (Term dashboard link) and puts the Term announcement on the students' board and bell. A later default-price change leaves the Term's prices alone, an Application pays the Term's Deposit, and once an Invoice exists the prices are locked.

methods.name: publishedTermChangesWithinTheRules
methods.comment: TC-CFG-022: after publishing, a passed date is fixed and an open deadline is only extended; a change needs a reason and becomes a change announcement with old → new values (also in Vietnamese); the rules stay fixed.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.TerminationIT
comment: Terminations of stays (spec §6.15, D-27): started by a Manager (or the Utility debt rule), cancelled only by a Manager with a reason, Overdue after the move-out date with the door code rotated, closed by the check-out with the unused room fee refunded by its rule (TC-ASG-035, 036).

methods.name: managerTerminatesAndCancels
methods.comment: TC-ASG-035: a Manager terminates a resident's stay with a reason: Notice sent with the move-out date, the student is told (in-app and email) and sees it on My Room, the desk lists the check-out; Staff read it but may not start or cancel; one termination at a time; a Manager cancels it with a reason and the student is told.

methods.name: overdueThenCheckedOut
methods.comment: TC-ASG-036: past the move-out date the termination is Overdue: Managers and the Block's Staff are told, the Room's door code must change and the student no longer sees it; the check-out closes the termination and refunds the unused room fee by its rule (Not enrolled 30 %, decided by a Manager).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.TestAuth
comment: Sign-in helpers for integration tests (seed accounts share one password).

methods.name: bearer
methods.comment: Signs in and returns the {@code Authorization} header value.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.UtilityDebtIT
comment: Utility debt (spec §6.14, D-27): warning 1 for an overdue Utility Invoice, the final warning with its termination day, warnings closed by paying everything, and the termination when two months are overdue or the debt reaches the Utility Deposit held (TC-BIL-037, 038).

methods.name: resident
methods.comment: A resident of A-110 whose paid Balance holds a Utility Deposit of 600,000 VND.

methods.name: warningsThenPaidInFull
methods.comment: TC-BIL-037: an overdue Utility Invoice gives warning 1 (in-app and email), once; a second overdue month gives the final warning with the termination day (today + 3); paying everything closes both.

methods.name: debtTerminatesTheStay
methods.comment: TC-BIL-038 (business rule): from the termination day, two overdue months terminate the stay (notice to the student, the Managers' list); a debt reaching the Utility Deposit does too, even in its first month; with that rule off one month does not, and nothing happens before the termination day.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.common.i18n.MessagesTest
comment: How the API's English messages become Vietnamese (ADR-25; TC-NTF-036, 037).

methods.name: translatesExactTextsAndTemplates
methods.comment: TC-NTF-036: exact texts and texts with values are translated, a value from the catalog too; English stays English.

methods.name: keepsWhatItCannotTranslate
methods.comment: TC-NTF-037: a text without a translation, an unknown language and null are returned unchanged.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.config.EmailSenderConfigTest
comment: Where emails go: the recipient, or for fictional accounts the demo mailbox of campusstay.mail.redirect-to (TC-NTF-034, 035, 039).

methods.name: redirectsToTheDemoMailbox
methods.comment: TC-NTF-034: with a demo mailbox an email to a fictional account goes there, the recipient in the subject and a header.

methods.name: deliversNormallyOrOnlyLogs
methods.comment: TC-NTF-035: without it the email goes to its recipient unchanged; without SMTP nothing is sent or thrown.

methods.name: realAccountsAreNotRedirected
methods.comment: TC-NTF-039: a real account receives its own email even while a demo mailbox is set (spec O-3).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.config.EmailSenderConfigTest$CapturingSender
comment: Keeps the messages instead of opening an SMTP connection.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.security.SecurityConfigCorsTest
comment: CORS origins for the deployed web app (ADR-16). Test case IDs follow TC-AUTH-NNN (Report 5).

methods.name: admitsExactOriginAndPreviewPattern
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-034: an exact origin and a Vercel preview pattern are both admitted.

methods.name: refusesOtherOriginsAndBlankSetting
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-035 (negative): other origins are refused, and a blank setting keeps CORS closed.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.AssignmentEngineTest
comment: The rule-based engine alone, without a database (TC-ASG-001…006).

methods.name: pairFirstIntoEmptyTwoBedRoom
methods.comment: TC-ASG-001: an invited pair shares an empty 2-bed Room; the next student gets NO_BED when none is left.

methods.name: ineligibleStudentIsFlagged
methods.comment: TC-ASG-002: a student who is no longer eligible is flagged and never placed.

methods.name: partnerNotReady
methods.comment: TC-ASG-003: an invited partner who is not in the run blocks the pair (PARTNER_NOT_READY).

methods.name: bestFitRoom
methods.comment: TC-ASG-004: a single student joins the Room whose occupant shares the most attributes.

methods.name: priorityOrderAndDeterminism
methods.comment: TC-ASG-005: the priority group goes first; the same input gives the same proposal.

methods.name: lowFitIsInformation
methods.comment: TC-ASG-006: a placement with few shared attributes is kept and marked LOW_FIT (information only).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.HandoverComparisonTest
comment: How a check-in inventory is compared with the Room's record (TC-ASG-047…052).

methods.name: wornMatchesGood
methods.comment: TC-ASG-047: Good and Worn count as the same, and meters within the tolerance match.

methods.name: oneDamagedItemIsMinor
methods.comment: TC-ASG-048: one item reported Damaged where the record says Good is a minor difference.

methods.name: missingItemIsMajor
methods.comment: TC-ASG-049: an item the record had in the Room reported Missing needs a visit.

methods.name: manyDifferencesAreMajor
methods.comment: TC-ASG-050: three differing items need a visit.

methods.name: meterLimitGrowsWithTimeAndResidents
methods.comment: TC-ASG-051: the meter limit grows with the hours since the reading and the residents.

methods.name: itemsWithoutRecordAreNotCompared
methods.comment: TC-ASG-052: items the record does not know are never a difference.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assistant.OllamaAssistantModelTest
comment: The assistant's Ollama adapter (ADR-28).

methods.name: postsTheChatAndReadsTheAnswer
methods.comment: TC-AST-006: the chat is posted unstreamed with the model, the context size and the proxy key; the answer is read.

methods.name: offlineWhenTheServerFails
