methods.comment: TC-AST-007: a missing model (404) or an unreachable server answers 503 ASSISTANT_OFFLINE.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.auth.GoogleCodeExchangerTest
comment: Google authorization-code exchange (ADR-14). Test case IDs follow TC-AUTH-NNN (Report 5).

methods.name: exchangesCodeForIdToken
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-029: the code is posted with the popup redirect URI and the ID token is returned.

methods.name: redirectFlowSendsThePage
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-051: a code of the redirect flow (popup blocked) is exchanged with the sign-in page as redirect URI.

methods.name: usedCodeIsInvalid
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-030 (negative): a used or expired code is the user's retryable error (401).

methods.name: wrongClientSecretIsUnavailable
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-031 (negative): a wrong client secret is our misconfiguration, not the user's (503).

methods.name: networkFailureIsUnavailable
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-032 (negative): Google cannot be reached (503).

methods.name: codeFlowNeedsClientSecret
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-033 (boundary): without a client secret the code flow is off and Google is never called.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.auth.GoogleSignUpIT
comment: Google sign-up (ADR-26, spec §6.1): a new account, its first password, the sign-up form, verification by the student list. Google's ID token check is replaced by a stub; the real check is covered by the code exchange tests and the manual test with a real account.

methods.name: google
methods.comment: Signs in with a stubbed Google identity and returns the response.

methods.name: imported
methods.comment: A student of an imported list who has not signed in yet.

methods.name: signUpThenSetAPassword
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-038: an unknown FPT Google account signs up as a student without a password; until it sets one only the setup endpoints answer; the password follows the usual rules and is set once.

methods.name: signUpFormWaitsForAManager
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-039: the sign-up form checks every field and the student code; once sent the account is Pending verification, every Manager is told, and the student cannot apply.

methods.name: codeInTheAddressFindsTheImportedStudent
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-040: an address ending with the code of an imported, unused account signs in to that account (Verified, linked to Google); a fictional account's code is never matched, and a real student who needs it takes it.

methods.name: rejectedAccountSaysWhy
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-041: a rejected account cannot sign in, and the answer gives the Manager's reason.

methods.name: demoBackOfficeAccountsRefuseGoogle
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-059 (security): a fictional back-office account of the seed signs in with its password only, so whoever owns that address at FPT cannot take its role through Google; a real staff account still can.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.billing.MeterRemindersIT
comment: Months whose meter period is not closed: Overviews and reminders to Staff (TC-BIL-040).

methods.name: lateMonthIsFlaggedAndRemindedOnce
methods.comment: TC-BIL-040: every Block gets this month's period; a month ended more than {@code utility.close_days} ago and still open is shown on the Staff and Manager Overviews, and its Block's Staff are reminded once a day.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.billing.UtilitySplitTest
comment: How a Room's meter is split between its residents (TC-BIL-022, 029…031).

methods.name: equalSharesForTheWholeMonth
methods.comment: TC-BIL-022: residents who lived in the Room the whole month pay equal shares.

methods.name: aCheckOutSplitsTheMonthIntoSegments
methods.comment: TC-BIL-029: a check-out cuts the meter; the leaver's share is marked settled (paid from the Utility Deposit).

methods.name: sharesFollowTimeInTheRoom
methods.comment: TC-BIL-030: within a segment, shares follow the time each resident lived in the Room; totals round up.

methods.name: noEndReadingNoShares
methods.comment: TC-BIL-031: without a reading at the end there is nothing to share yet.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.notification.FcmPushSenderTest
comment: FCM HTTP v1 sender against a mock Google (TC-NTF-010…012).

methods.name: sendsWithAccessToken
methods.comment: TC-NTF-010: a signed service-account JWT buys an access token; the message goes to the device.

methods.name: invalidTokenAndFailure
methods.comment: TC-NTF-011: an unregistered device token is reported so it can be disabled; other errors are failures.

methods.name: assertionIsSigned
methods.comment: TC-NTF-012: the JWT is RS256-signed with the service account key and names the FCM scope.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.notification.TestPushSenders
comment: A recording stand-in for FCM in integration tests; the device token {@code expired} is reported as unregistered.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.report.ExportServiceTest
comment: How exports write CSV cells (TC-RPT-009).

methods.name: writesSafeCells
methods.comment: TC-RPT-009: quoting, empty cells, campus times, and text a spreadsheet would run as a formula.
